original_ai_output.title_zh: 刚果（金）马西西地区再起战事，非盟代表团紧急斡旋停火
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 刚果（金）东部马西西地区周三再次爆发战斗，此前一天非洲联盟调解小组访问了戈马。刚果（金）东部数十年来冲突不断，众多武装团体争夺矿产资源丰富的领土，其中包括M23。据称该组织去年在卢旺达支持下又夺取了北基伍和南基伍两省更多地区。

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）东部马西西地区周三再次爆发战斗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: New fighting broke out Wednesday in Masisi, in eastern DR Congo, a day after the African Union Panel of Facilitators visited Goma.

key_facts.fact: 非洲联盟调解小组此前一天访问了戈马
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a day after the African Union Panel of Facilitators visited Goma

key_facts.fact: 刚果（金）东部数十年来冲突不断，众多武装团体争夺矿产资源
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has been riven by decades of conflict, with myriad armed groups fighting over its mineral-rich territory, including the M23.

key_facts.fact: 据称M23去年在卢旺达支持下夺取北基伍和南基伍两省更多地区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Rwanda-backed anti-governmental group seized further swathes of the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu last year.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews），尚缺乏交叉验证
M23与卢旺达的关联为报道所述，未获独立确认
